payload.reason: The evidence explains the difference between human evaluation accuracy and automatic evaluation F1 scores, indicating that higher absolute accuracy numbers suggest better performance in human evaluations compared to F1 scores, which may not capture all correct answers.

claims.text: Higher absolute accuracy numbers compared to F1 scores indicate that human evaluations assess correctness more comprehensively than automatic evaluations, which may miss some correct answers.
The discrepancy between human evaluation accuracy and automatic evaluation F1 scores arises because automatic evaluations cannot account for all possible correct answers to open-ended questions.
